Installs Melissa 4.5.0 for all users from the upstream GitHub release, verified by pinned SHA-256 (installer is unsigned).

If Node.js (MSI) is installed, keeps it on the latest release of the same major line from nodejs.org, verified by SHASUMS256 and the OpenJS Foundation signature. Does not install Node.js where absent.
